title: Margin Call Best Quote by Will Emerson
summary: A two-minute clip from the film Margin Call in which Will Emerson talks about how banks and traders operate and why they stay necessary. The uploader posted it because they agree with the speech.
why: HN cites it as a compact explanation of the housing crash and of institutions keeping their fingers on the scales.

quote.text: I had to search for this excellent clip from Margin Call, which explains this better than I could
